narrative.scqa_heading: Report Synthesis — Sunflower Bank DMA Assessment
narrative.scqa_md:
Sunflower Bank, N.A. is a $20.4B in assets regional bank regulated by FDIC, operating since 1892 with 2,500 employees. A 45.9% multi-year growth rate gives it the balance sheet to fund transformation [E-053, E-041]. Zennify's assessment places overall digital maturity at 1.9/5.

The deepest capability gap is Behavioral Data Capture at 1.3/5 against a 2.0 peer median [E-024, E-032]. Next is AI & ML Strategy & Governance at 1.4/5 against a 2.0 peer median [E-093, E-121]. Third is Data Quality Framework & Dimensions at 1.4/5 against a 2.0 peer median [E-088, E-118]. Counter-signal: Strategy Foundation & Alignment already runs at 2.8/5 against a 2.5 peer median — a strength to build on, not rebuild.

The question for Sunflower Bank, N.A. is whether to close Behavioral Data Capture first — the constraint the other investments inherit — or continue layering point solutions on top of it and accept the compounding operating cost. Sunflower Bank, N.A. should lead with nCino (64/100 fit) against Leader Role Modeling, then sequence Tableau behind it.

Closing Behavioral Data Capture to the peer median alone is worth 0.7 maturity points, and the capabilities that depend on it compound the gain.
